specs.source_title: Supplementary instructions for accessories in the P1S box
specs.quote: The P1S package comes with a 32 GB Micro SD card (pre-installed in the printer), screen, spool holder, filament, spare hotend, nozzle wiping pads, power cord, unclogging pin tool, PTFE tube, …
